input.quote: (b) injury or death of patients participating in any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Array anywhere in the world, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, (c) injury or death of patients participating in Clinical Studies conducted under any Joint Development Plan and sponsored by or on behalf of Array, including any Products Liability Claim arising therefrom, and (d) any breach of any representations, warranties or covenants by Array in Article 15 above, except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee.
input.rationale: Array does give Ono and its Affiliates a Third Party Claim indemnity (16.2) with a full procedure (notice, control, cooperation in 16.3), but its heads are limited to Array-side commercialisation, Array-sponsored Clinical Studies and breach of Article 15 reps. There is no indemnity for third-party intellectual-property infringement arising from the licensed Array Patents, Array Know-How or Array-supplied Products (Section 11.4 instead leaves the Subject Party to defend Infringement Actions at its own expense, and Article 15 contains no non-infringement warranty), no cover for Array's breach of Law, Array-caused disclosure of Ono Confidential Information or Array's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and no express duty to defend. Ono's own indemnity in 16.1 is by contrast very broad. That fails both the fallback (no Vendor IP indemnity at all) and the preferred position, so we target preferred: adding "defend", four new indemnity heads and narrowing Ono's indemnity to Ono-supplied content and Ono's breach of Law, while leaving 16.3 untouched.

ops.text: Array shall further defend and indemnify the Ono Indemnitees, notwithstanding Section 11.4, against any Third Party Claim alleging that the Array Patents, Array Know-How or Products supplied by Array infringe any intellectual property right, or arising from Array's breach of Law, any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Ono Confidential Information caused by Array, or Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

ops.newText: (a) any materials, data or other content provided by Ono to Array; and

ops.newText: (b) any breach of applicable Law by Ono; except to the extent such Third Party Claims result from the gross negligence or willful misconduct of an Array Indemnitee.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added Array's express duty to defend and extended its indemnity to third-party IP infringement claims, Array's breach of Law, Array-caused disclosure of Ono Confidential Information and Array's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and correspondingly narrowed Ono's indemnity to Ono-supplied content and Ono's breach of Law; the notice, control and cooperation mechanics in Section 16.3 are unchanged.
proposal.summary: Add Array defence duty and IP/law/data/misconduct indemnity heads; narrow Ono's indemnity
